verdict.rationale: Attio Workflows supports event-triggered automation (e.g. 'When a new deal is created') and custom triggers/blocks via the SDK, showing genuine workflow automation depth, but no evidence describes time-based or cron-style recurring schedules for jobs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a time/schedule-based trigger type, evidence of recurring execution intervals, and confirmation that workflows can run on a cadence rather than only in response to events.
